Controls

From Balatro Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search

The following is a list of controls in Balatro.

Contents

  • 1 PC
  • 2 Consoles
    • 2.1 PlayStation
    • 2.2 Xbox
    • 2.3 Nintendo Switch
  • 3 Mobile

PC

[edit | edit source]
Control Action
Use Left click Select/deselect any card and booster packs, select blind, or press any other button.
Hold Left click Hold and drag any card to move it.
Use Right click Deselect all selected playing cards.
Hold R Restart a run, on the current deck and stake. If a specific seed was set by the player, it will be reused.

Consoles

[edit | edit source]
  • The game is fully playable with a single joystick and four buttons; the joystick either navigates directly between all selectable options or moves a cursor.
  • For all consoles, playing a hand and discarding are done by navigating to the on-screen buttons, not a dedicated face button.

PlayStation

[edit | edit source]
Control Action
Cross Select/confirm
Circle Cancel/back
L1 and R1 Buy/use/sell cards.

Xbox

[edit | edit source]
Control Action
A Select/confirm
B Cancel/back
LB and RB (Xbox) Buy/use/sell cards.

Nintendo Switch

[edit | edit source]
Control Action
B Select/confirm
A Cancel/back
L and R (Switch) Buy/use/sell cards.

Mobile

[edit | edit source]
Control Action
Tap Select/deselect any card and booster packs, select blind, or press any other button.
Hold Hold and drag any card to move it.

settings.text:
Settings

From Balatro Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search

Settings is the first option that can be found within the Options menu. There, the player can modify many settings for Balatro, including ones that have to do with graphics, video, and audio.

The following is a list of settings and their configurations. When a setting is changed by a player, it will be applied across all profiles.

Contents

  • 1 Game settings
  • 2 Video settings
  • 3 Graphics settings
  • 4 Audio settings

Game settings

[edit | edit source]
Setting Options Default option Details
Game Speed 0.5, 1, 2, 4 1 Affects the speed of card animations (e.g. when playing cards are scored, when jokers are triggered, when tarot cards are used, etc.)
Play/Discard Button Position Play/Discard, Discard/Play Play/Discard Determines the positions of the "Play Hand" and the "Discard" buttons during a round.
Screenshake 0% → 100%
Desktop: 30%
Mobile: 50%
 Determines how much the screen shakes during certain events, such as when the cursor is significantly moving, when playing cards are scored, or when jokers are triggered.
Display Stake Stickers during Run On, Off Off Determines whether to showcase the highest stake that the player used a specific Joker for or not. For more info on how Stake Stickers work, see Stake Stickers.
High Contrast Cards On, Off Off Determines whether playing cards should show up with a high contrast or not. By selecting this option, the following changes will occur:
  • The Clubs suit will become light blue;
  • The Diamonds suit will become orange;
  • The Heart suit will become a slightly more saturated red;
  • The Spade suit will become a slightly darker black;
  • Face cards will be altered for higher contrast.

The player can also change this setting in the "Customize Deck" interface.

Reduced Motion On, Off Off By selecting this option, it will disable the idle and triggering animations of cards, the background animation, and the animation of text. Furthermore, it will disable screenshake, regardless of what it is set to.

Video settings

[edit | edit source]
Setting Options Default option Details
Display Monitor Number of monitors 1 Determines the monitor for the game to be displayed.
Window Mode Windowed, Fullscreen, Borderless Borderless Determines the type of window Balatro will have.
  • If it is set to "Windowed", Balatro's window will no longer be full screen, and the player can resize their window however they like, but not through the in-game Resolution setting (where it would be marked as - after this setting is applied.)
  • If it is set to "Fullscreen", Balatro's window will be full screen, but the player will be able to customize their resolution
  • If it is set to "Borderless", Balatro's window will be full screen with the monitor's default resolution display. The player wouldn't be able to set a custom resolution if this setting is applied.
Resolution List of resolutions supported by current monitor System resolution Determines the quality of the display of the game's window. Supports ultra-widescreen and 4K+ resolutions. Unavailable if Window Mode is Windowed, and fixed to system resolution if it is Borderless
VSync VSync On, VSync Off VSync On Determines whether to enable Vertical Synchronization (VSync). If VSync is off, Balatro attempts to cap FPS to 500.

To update any of these settings, the player must select their desired video settings, then press "Apply". Doing so will restart the game with the chosen settings.

These settings are not available on mobile version.

Graphics settings

[edit | edit source]
Setting Options Default option Details
Shadows On, Off On Determines whether UI buttons and cards have shadows beneath them or not.
Pixel Art Smoothing Off, On On Determines whether anti-aliasing is applied or not. Also loads all assets in double the resolution when enabled.
CRT 0% → 100%
Desktop: 70%
Mobile: 30%
 Determines whether a CRT-style monitor display (shadow mask, scanlines and image distortion) is applied or not.
CRT Bloom Off, On On Determines whether a CRT-style blooming is applied or not; not available on mobile version. This setting does not do anything if CRT is 0%.

Audio settings

[edit | edit source]
Setting Options Default option Details
Master Volume 0% → 100% 80% Affects Music Volume and Game Volume.
Music Volume 0% → 100% 100% Affects the volume of the game's background music.
Game Volume 0% → 100% 100% Affects the volume of the game's sound effects.

scoring.text:
Guide: Activation Sequence

From Balatro Wiki
(Redirected from Scoring)
Jump to navigation Jump to search
This article is a Guide.
This guide has been created by wiki members as a helpful resource, and is not official.
If there is any missing, incorrect, or out of date information, please help by editing this page.

Activation sequence is a core mechanic of Balatro and its understanding can be crucial to strategy building and optimization.

Contents

  • 1 Hand Sequence
  • 2 Strategic Card Arrangement
    • 2.1 Additive Mult - Multiplicative Mult Order
    • 2.2 Other Arrangements

Hand Sequence

[edit | edit source]

When a hand is played, effects will activate in the following orders. (Some Jokers may have different parts trigger at different stages: for example, (This Joker gains {{Chips|+8}} when each played {{hl|orange|2}} is scored <br> {{Currently|{{chips|+0}}}} Win a run in {{hl|orange|18}} or fewer rounds Rare Chips Mixed Wee Joker.png) Wee Joker gain chips 'on scored' and adds chips to total 'independently').

  1. Boss blind effects: Boss blinds such as ( Boss The Flint.webp) The Flint or ( Boss The Arm.webp) The Arm will activate.
  2. 'On played' Jokers: Jokers that activate when a hand is played, and before any scoring happens. Examples include ({{mult|+1}} per hand played <br> {{mult|-1}} per discard <br> {{Currently|{{mult|+0}}}} Common Additive Mult Mixed Green_Joker.png) Green Joker's scaling, (If {{hl|orange|first hand}} of round has only {{hl|orange|1}} card, add a permanent copy to deck and draw it to {{hl|orange|hand}} Rare Effect On Played DNA.png) DNA, and (Earn {{Money|4}} if [[Poker hands|{{hl|orange|poker hand}}]] is a [[Poker hands|{{hl|orange|[Poker Hand]}}]], poker hand changes at end of round Common Economy On Played To_Do_List.png) To Do List.
  3. Played cards scoring: Cards played and scored activate from left to right. For each card, its effects activate in the following order:
    1. Base effect (Chips): The card activates its base effect, giving the accorded amount of Chips. Bonus chips are included in this value.
    2. Card modifiers: Card modifiers activate in the following order: enhancements, then seals (currently only (Earn {{money|3}} when this card is played and scores Seal Gold Seal.png) Gold Seal), then editions.
    3. 'On scored' Jokers: Jokers that activate on a played and scored card will activate their effects. When multiple Jokers are triggered by the same card, they activate from left to right. Examples include (This Joker gains {{Chips|+8}} when each played {{hl|orange|2}} is scored <br> {{Currently|{{chips|+0}}}} Win a run in {{hl|orange|18}} or fewer rounds Rare Chips Mixed Wee Joker.png) Wee Joker's scaling, (Played {{hl|orange|face}} cards give {{mult|+5}} when scored Common Additive Mult On Scored Smiley Face.png) Smiley Face, and (Played Kings and Queens each give {{xmult|2}} when scored Find this [[Jokers|Joker]] from the [[the Soul|{{hl|sblue|Soul}}]] card. Legendary Multiplicative Mult On Scored Triboulet.png) Triboulet.
    4. Retriggers: Each retrigger repeats the previous activation sequence (from base effects to scored card dependent Jokers) one more time. Multiple retriggers stack additively. (Retrigger this card {{hl|orange|1}} time Seal Red Seal.png) Red Seal would go first, followed by retriggering Jokers from left to right.
  4. Held in hand abilities: Cards in hand are checked from left to right if they can activate in-hand abilities. The sequence for each card is similar to scored cards.
    1. Enhancement ( ({{xmult|1.5}} while this card stays in hand Enhancement Steel Card.png) Steel cards): Currently Steel is the only card modifier to activate in-hand for each hand.
    2. 'On held' Jokers: Jokers that activate on cards still held in hand will activate their effects. When multiple Jokers are triggered by a single card, they activate from left to right. Examples include (Adds {{hl|orange|double}} the rank of {{hl|orange|lowest}} ranked card held in hand to Mult Common Additive Mult On Held Raised Fist.png) Raised Fist, (Each {{hl|orange|Queen}} held in hand gives {{mult|+13}} Play every Heart card in your deck in one round. Common Additive Mult On Held Shoot the Moon.png) Shoot the Moon, and (Each {{hl|orange|King}} held in hand gives {{xmult|1.5}} Rare Multiplicative Mult On Held Baron.png) Baron.
    3. Retriggers: Same as those of scored cards, retriggers of cards in hand stack additively. (Retrigger this card {{hl|orange|1}} time Seal Red Seal.png) Red Seal will activate first, then (Retrigger all card {{hl|orange|held in hand}} abilities Uncommon Retrigger On Held Mime.png) Mime and any other Joker copying its effect from left to right.
  5. Joker Editions and 'Independent' Jokers: Jokers are checked from left to right to score any Edition ( ({{chips|+50}} Edition Joker (Foil).png) Foil, ({{mult|+10}} Edition Joker (Holographic).png) Holographic and ({{xmult|1.5}} Edition Joker (Polychrome).png) Polychrome) and activate Independent abilities:
    1. Foil or holographic bonus.
    2. 'Independent' Jokers: Jokers that trigger after all the playing cards are scored will activate their base ability. These do not get affected by retriggers. Examples include ({{mult|+1}} per [[Tarot Cards|{{hl|purple|Tarot}}]] card used this run <br> {{currently|{{hl|red|+0}}}} Common Additive Mult Independent Fortune Teller.png) Fortune Teller, ({{xmult|2}} if played hand contains a {{ph|Pair}} Win a run without playing a {{ph|Pair}}. Rare Multiplicative Mult Independent The Duo.png) The Duo, and ({{xmult|3}} if all cards held in hand are {{suit|Spades}} or {{suit|Clubs}} Uncommon Multiplicative Mult Independent Blackboard.png) Blackboard.
    3. Jokers dependent on other Jokers (currently, only ([[Uncommon Jokers|{{hl|green|Uncommon}}]] Jokers each give {{xmult|1.5}} Rare Multiplicative Mult On Other Jokers Baseball Card.png) Baseball Card).
    4. Polychrome bonus.
  6. Consumables: When the ({{Planet|}} cards in your [[Consumables|{{hl|orange|consumable}}]] area give {{xmult|1.5}} for their specified [[Poker hands|{{hl|orange|poker hand}}]] Use a total of {{hl|orange|25}} [[Planet|{{hl|cyan|Planet}}]] cards from any {{hl|cyan|Celestial Pack}} Upgraded Observatory.png) Observatory Voucher has been purchased, planet cards give X1.5 Mult, activating from left to right.
  7. Plasma Deck balance: Lastly, if using the ( Balance [[Chips|{{hl|blue|Chips}}]] and [[Mult|{{hl|red|Mult}}]] when calculating score for played hand <br> {{hl|red|X2}} base Blind size Win a run with any [[Decks|deck]] on the {{Stake|Blue}} difficulty or harder Plasma Deck.png) Plasma Deck, Chips and Mult are balanced.

See Activation Type for a full list of when different Jokers activate.

Strategic Card Arrangement

[edit | edit source]

Additive Mult - Multiplicative Mult Order

[edit | edit source]

Almost all card arrangement problems stem from the order of additive Mult and multiplicative Mult. According to the law of distribution, the +Mult activating before the xMult gives a higher score. For example, a hand normally scoring 40 x 4 is played and a +4 Mult ({{Mult|+4}} Common Additive Mult Independent Joker.png) Joker and a X2 Mult ({{xmult|2}}, loses {{xmult|0.01}} per {{hl|orange|card}} discarded Uncommon Multiplicative Mult Mixed Ramen.png) Ramen is present. If the Joker is on the left of Ramen, the hand will score 40 x ((4+4)x2) = 640 chips whereas the reversed placement will only score 40 x ((4x2)+4) = 480 chips. This concept applies to the order of cards played and in hand as well as Jokers. For a higher score, the player may arrange in the following ways:

  1. Put Jokers with additive Mult to the left of multiplicative Mult of the same Activation Type type. E.g. Joker left of Ramen, (Played cards with {{Suit|Heart}} suit give {{Mult|+3}} when scored Common Additive Mult On Scored Lusty Joker.png) Lusty Joker left of ({{hl|green|1 in 2}} chance for played cards with {{suit|Heart}} suit to give {{xmult|1.5}} when scored Have at least {{hl|orange|30}} cards with {{hl|orange|Heart}} suit in your deck Uncommon Multiplicative Mult On Scored Bloodstone.png) Bloodstone, (Adds {{hl|orange|double}} the rank of {{hl|orange|lowest}} ranked card held in hand to Mult Common Additive Mult On Held Raised Fist.png) Raised Fist left of (Each {{hl|orange|King}} held in hand gives {{xmult|1.5}} Rare Multiplicative Mult On Held Baron.png) Baron.
  2. For cards about to be played, put those that give +Mult (e.g. ({{mult|+4}} Enhancement Mult Card.png) Mult cards, cards with  Diamond suit with (Played cards with {{Suit|Diamond}} suit give {{Mult|+3}} when scored Common Additive Mult On Scored Greedy Joker.png) Greedy Joker) left of those that give xMult (e.g. ({{xmult|2}}<br>{{hl|green|1 in 4}} chance to destroy card Enhancement Glass Card.png) Glass cards, ({{xmult|1.5}} Edition Joker (Polychrome).png) Polychrome cards, cards selected by (Each played [[Card Ranks|{{hl|orange|[rank]}}]] of [[Card Suits|{{hl|orange|[suit]}}]] gives {{xmult|2}} when scored<br><small>Card changes every round</small> In one hand, earn at least {{hl|orange|1,000,000}} chips Uncommon Multiplicative Mult On Scored The Idol.png) The Idol).
  3. For cards about to be kept in hand, put +Mult on the left of xMult. E.g. Queens with (Each {{hl|orange|Queen}} held in hand gives {{mult|+13}} Play every Heart card in your deck in one round. Common Additive Mult On Held Shoot the Moon.png) Shoot the Moon left of ({{xmult|1.5}} while this card stays in hand Enhancement Steel Card.png) Steel cards.

In case the player wanted a lower score for purposes like scaling Jokers, they may put +Mult to the right of xMult.

Other Arrangements

[edit | edit source]

Some cards with special abilities can give different outcomes when arranged differently.

  1. Putting (All played {{hl|orange|face}} cards become [[Gold cards|{{hl|orange|Gold}}]] cards when scored Uncommon Effect On Played Midas_Mask.png) Midas Mask to the left of (This Joker gains {{xmult|0.1}} per scoring {{hl|orange|Enhanced card}} played, removes card {{hl|orange|Enhancement}} <br> {{Currently|{{xmult|1}}}} Uncommon Multiplicative Mult Mixed Vampire.png) Vampire ensures the bigger boost to Vampire. The reversed placement provides less Vampire scaling but leaves ({{money|3}} if this card is held in hand at end of round Enhancement Gold Card.png) Gold cards in the deck.

shop.text:
The Shop

From Balatro Wiki
(Redirected from Shop)
Jump to navigation Jump to search

The Shop is the location where Jokers, Consumables, and Vouchers can be acquired by spending money. The Shop is only accessible after defeating a ( Standard Small Blind.webp) Small Blind, ( Standard Big Blind.webp) Big Blind, or Boss Blind.

By default, the shop sells:

  • 2 random cards (usually Jokers, but occasionally Tarot, Planet, and Playing cards if you have purchased the ({{hl|orange|Playing cards}} can be purchased from the [[The Shop|{{hl|orange|shop}}]] Base Magic Trick.png) Magic Trick voucher, or Spectral cards if you are playing with ( {{Spectral|}} cards may appear in the shop, start with a {{spectral|Hex}} card Win a run with the {{D|Yellow}} on [[Stakes|any difficulty]] Ghost Deck.png) Ghost Deck.)
  • 2 random Booster Packs (except for the first visit to any Shop in a run, where one normal () Buffoon Pack is guaranteed)
  • 1 Voucher

Contents

  • 1 Weights
  • 2 Vouchers
  • 3 Reroll
  • 4 Pricing

    • 4.3 Edition cost

Weights

[edit | edit source]

Weights determine how likely a card is to appear in the given set. The higher the weight, the more it appears. The random cards sold are drawn with the default weights:

  • Joker: 20
  • Tarot: 4
  • Planet: 4

This can be rewritten to the approximate chances of each card appearing as following (note that these are rounded):

  • Joker: 71.4%
  • Tarot: 14.3%
  • Planet: 14.3%

In addition, when a Joker is generated, the different rarities have specific weights as well. The default values for these are:

  • Common: 70%
  • Uncommon: 25%
  • Rare: 5%

Vouchers

[edit | edit source]

With the ({{hl|orange|Playing cards}} can be purchased from the [[The Shop|{{hl|orange|shop}}]] Base Magic Trick.png) Magic Trick Voucher, playing cards are given a weight of 4; the ({{hl|orange|Playing cards}} in shop may have an [[Card modifiers#Enhancements|{{hl|sblue|Enhancement}}]], [[Card modifiers#Edition|{{hl|edition|Edition}}]], and/or a [[Card modifiers#Seal|{{hl|orange|Seal}}]] Buy a total of 20 Playing cards from the shop Upgraded Illusion.png) Illusion Voucher makes playing cards enhanced 40% of the time, editioned 20% of the time, and is unaffected by ({{hl|edition|Foil}}, {{hl|edition|Holographic}}, and {{hl|edition|Polychrome}} cards appear {{hl|orange|2X}} more often Base Hone.png) Hone/ ({{hl|edition|Foil}}, {{hl|edition|Holographic}}, and {{hl|edition|Polychrome}} cards appear {{hl|orange|4X}} more often Have at least 5 Joker cards with Foil, Holographic, or Polychrome (or Negative) effect Upgraded Glow Up.png) Glow Up. The ({{Tarot|}} cards appear {{hl|orange|2X}} more frequently in the shop Base Tarot Merchant.png) Tarot Merchant Voucher raises the Tarot card weight to 9.6 while the ({{Tarot|}} cards appear {{hl|orange|4X}} more frequently in the shop Buy a total of 50 Tarot cards from the shop Upgraded Tarot Tycoon.png) Tarot Tycoon Voucher raises the weight to 32. The ({{Planet|}} cards appear {{hl|orange|2X}} more frequently in the shop Base Planet Merchant.png) Planet Merchant and ({{Planet|}} cards appear {{hl|orange|4X}} more frequently in the shop Buy a total of 50 Planet cards from the shop Upgraded Planet Tycoon.png) Planet Tycoon Vouchers work in the same way for their respective Planets. With the ( {{Spectral|}} cards may appear in the shop, start with a {{spectral|Hex}} card Win a run with the {{D|Yellow}} on [[Stakes|any difficulty]] Ghost Deck.png) Ghost Deck, Spectral cards can appear with a weight of 2.

The number of available random cards can be increased by the ({{hl|orange|+1}} card slot available in shop Base Overstock.png) Overstock and ({{hl|orange|+1}} card slot available in shop Spend a total of {{Money|2500}} at the shop Upgraded Overstock Plus.png) Overstock Plus Vouchers, which increases the number of sold cards to 3 and 4 respectively.

Reroll

[edit | edit source]

The player may pay money to reroll the shop an unlimited number of times, removing any of the remaining random cards and replacing them with 2 new random cards. Note that because the rerolls are random, cards seen before rerolling can also appear again. The reroll cost starts at $5 and increases by $1 each reroll, resetting to $5 upon entering a new shop. (Rerolls cost {{Money|2}} less Base Reroll Surplus.png) Reroll Surplus and (Rerolls cost an additional {{Money|2}} less Reroll the shop a total of 100 times Upgraded Reroll Glut.png) Reroll Glut decrease the initial price to $3 and $1, respectively. ({{hl|orange|1}} free {{hl|green|Reroll}} per shop Common Effect N/A (Passive) Chaos_the_Clown.png) Chaos the Clown will make the first reroll free. The ( D6 tag.png) D6 Tag starts the rerolls on the next shop to $0.

However, rerolling the shop does not restock Booster Packs or the Voucher. Booster packs only restock upon entering a new shop, and the Voucher restocks after defeating the boss blind.

(This Joker gains {{Mult|+2}} per {{hl|orange|reroll}} in [[The Shop|the shop]] <br> {{Currently|{{mult|+0}}}} Uncommon Additive Mult Independent Flash Card.png) Flash Card has a special synergy with rerolling, as it scales when rerolling the shop.

Pricing

[edit | edit source]

In short

[edit | edit source]

All items have a buy cost (purchase price) and a sell value, which are recalculated every time the player interacts with the item. These follow consistent formulas for calculating them, with some exceptions applied due to other in-game items.[1]

Here follows a simplified formula for calculating an item's buy cost and sell value. For more details, see the Calculating buy cost and Calculating sell value sections.

buy_cost = (base_cost + edition_cost) * discount_percent
sell_value = floor(buy_cost / 2)

Base cost

[edit | edit source]

All items have a base cost, even Legendary Jokers (which can't be found in the shop). Playing cards can only be found in the Shop after purchasing the Magic Trick Voucher, and Spectral cards can only be found when playing with the ( {{Spectral|}} cards may appear in the shop, start with a {{spectral|Hex}} card Win a run with the {{D|Yellow}} on [[Stakes|any difficulty]] Ghost Deck.png) Ghost Deck.

Item Price
Jokers Common $1-6
Uncommon $4-8
Rare $7-10
Legendary $20
Playing cards $1
Tarot cards $3
Planet cards $3
Spectral cards $4
Booster Packs Normal $4
Jumbo $6
Mega $8
Vouchers $10

Edition cost

[edit | edit source]

Jokers can have Editions, which raises their price in the shop and their sell value. Consumables can have a Negative Edition when generated by (Creates a [[Negative|{{hl|edition|Negative}}]] copy of {{hl|orange|1}} random [[Consumables|{{hl|orange|consumable}}]] card in your possession at the end of the [[The Shop|{{hl|orange|shop}}]] Find this [[Jokers|Joker]] from the [[the Soul|{{hl|sblue|Soul}}]] card. Legendary Effect N/A (Passive) Perkeo.png) Perkeo, but they can never be found in the shop with an Edition. When ({{hl|orange|Playing cards}} in shop may have an [[Card modifiers#Enhancements|{{hl|sblue|Enhancement}}]], [[Card modifiers#Edition|{{hl|edition|Edition}}]], and/or a [[Card modifiers#Seal|{{hl|orange|Seal}}]] Buy a total of 20 Playing cards from the shop Upgraded Illusion.png) Illusion is bought, Playing cards can also have Editions in the shop, increasing their price.

Edition Added cost
Jokers Consumables Playing cards
({{chips|+50}} Edition Joker (Foil).png) Foil +$2 N/A +$2
({{mult|+10}} Edition Joker (Holographic).png) Holographic +$3 N/A +$3
({{xmult|1.5}} Edition Joker (Polychrome).png) Polychrome +$5 N/A +$5
({{hl|edition|+1}} Joker or Consumable slot Edition Joker (Negative).png) Negative +$5 +$5 N/A

Discounts

[edit | edit source]

After purchasing the Clearance Sale and Liquidation Vouchers, a 25% or 50% discount is applied to the buy cost of all items in the shop. This also indirectly affects the sell value of all items.

  • (All cards and packs in shop are {{hl|orange|25%}} off Base Clearance Sale.png) Clearance Sale (25% off) effectively sets discount_percent = 0.75
  • (All cards and packs in shop are {{hl|orange|50%}} off Redeem at least 10 Voucher cards in one run Upgraded Liquidation.png) Liquidation (50% off) effectively sets discount_percent = 0.5

Special cases

[edit | edit source]
  • During the ( Permanently raise prices by {{Money|1}} on every purchase {{j|Credit Card}}Banned [[Vouchers]]: {{V|Clearance Sale}}, {{V|Liquidation}}) Inflation Challenge Deck, every item's price increases by $1 on every purchase. This increase in cost is applied at the same time as the Edition cost, before any discounts from Vouchers.
  • The (All {{hl|cyan|Planet}} cards and {{hl|cyan|Celestial Packs}} in the shop are {{hl|orange|free}} Discover every {{Planet|}} card Uncommon Effect N/A (Passive) Astronomer.png) Astronomer Joker will set the cost of Planets and Celestial Packs to $0.
  • The ( Coupon tag.png) Coupon Tag sets the buy cost of all items in the next Shop to $0, except for Vouchers which retain their normal pricing.
  • The (Lose {{$|3}} at end of round Sticker Rental Sticker.png) Rental sticker sets the buy cost of Jokers with this sticker to $1.
  • If the item is a Booster Pack, and the player is playing the tutorial and is in the first shop, the buy cost increases by $3.
    • This only applies to the first Shop. Subsequent Shops will have the intended price for Booster Packs.
  • The jokers (Gains {{Money|3}} of {{Hl|orange|sell value}} at end of round Common Economy N/A (Passive) Egg.png) Egg and (Add {{Money|1}} of {{hl|orange|sell value}} to every [[Jokers|{{hl|orange|Joker}}]] and [[Consumables|{{hl|orange|Consumable}}]] card at end of round Uncommon Economy N/A (Passive) Gift Card.png) Gift Card can add extra sell value to cards. This extra value is only applied to the sell value, and after all other steps. The added value is not influenced by the discount vouchers.

Calculating buy cost

[edit | edit source]
  1. Add up the item's:
    1. Base cost.
    2. Edition cost (if it has an Edition).
    3. Inflation costs (if playing the Inflation challenge).
  2. Multiply this total by the discount_percent from the discount vouchers.
  3. Round half down (for example, 8.5 is rounded to 8).
  4. If the buy price after rounding is $0 or lower, set it to $1.
  5. Apply any remaining special cases (such as Astronomer, the Rental Sticker, or the Coupon Tag).

Calculating sell value

[edit | edit source]
  1. Recalculate the item's total buy cost (applying any vouchers bought in-between, any special case that changes the buy cost, etc.).
  2. Divide the total buy cost by 2.
  3. Floor the result of the division (for example, 3.75 is rounded to 3).
  4. If the sell value after flooring is $0 or lower, set it to $1.
  5. Add any additional sell value gained from Egg or Gift Card.

Gallery

[edit | edit source]
  • A screenshot of the Shop, featuring Raised Fist and Hack on the two random slots, a Buffoon Pack and a Jumbo Celestial Pack on the two Booster Pack slots, and a Planet Merchant voucher on the voucher slot.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • The Shop's logo appears on an Ante Up! shirt due to an official merch collaboration with Fangamer.[2]

In other media

[edit | edit source]
  • The Shop's logo appears in the Ante Chamber stage in Vampire Survivors.

  // Ensure nav links follow saved locale only when i18n routing is enabled.
  document.addEventListener("astro:page-load", () => {
    try {
      const headerEl = document.querySelector('header[transition\\:name="header"]');
      const isI18nEnabled = headerEl?.getAttribute("data-i18n-enabled") === "true";
      if (!isI18nEnabled) return;

      const saved = (localStorage.getItem("locale") || "en").toString();
      const lower = saved.toLowerCase();
      // Keep English (and English variants like en-US) unprefixed
      if (!saved || lower === "en" || lower.startsWith("en-")) return;
      const prefix = saved === "zh-CN" ? "/zh/" : saved === "zh-TW" ? "/zh-tw/" : `/${lower}/`;
      const tweakRoot = (el) => {
        if (!el) return;
        const current = el.getAttribute("href") || "/";
        // Only rewrite when the current link points to site root (English)
        if (current === "/") el.setAttribute("href", prefix);
      };
      const tweakPath = (el, path) => {
        if (!el) return;
        const current = el.getAttribute("href") || path;
        // Rewrite if English path (no locale prefix)
        if (current === path) el.setAttribute("href", prefix + path.replace(/^\//, ""));
      };
      tweakRoot(document.getElementById("nav-home-link"));
      tweakRoot(document.getElementById("nav-home-link-mobile"));
      tweakPath(document.getElementById("nav-support-link"), "/support/");
      tweakPath(document.getElementById("nav-support-link-mobile"), "/support/");
      tweakPath(document.getElementById("nav-merch-link"), "/merch/");
      tweakPath(document.getElementById("nav-merch-link-mobile"), "/merch/");
    } catch {}
  });

--pos: center;" data-astro-image="constrained" width="888" height="712" class="relative z-10 object-contain"> </picture> </div> <div class="text-center z-50 text-yellow-300 transition-colors duration-200 group-hover:text-yellow-400" data-astro-cid-bbe6dxrz> <div class="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-m6x11 leading-tight" data-astro-cid-bbe6dxrz> <div data-astro-cid-bbe6dxrz>NEW MERCH</div> <div data-astro-cid-bbe6dxrz>LIVE</div> </div> </div> </a> </div> </div>  <script data-astro-rerun async>
  (() => {
    // Colors
    const COLORS = ["#ff6b35", "#f7931e", "#ffdc00", "#00a86b", "#0074d9", "#b10dc9", "#ff4136", "#2ecc40"];
    // Standard poker card aspect ratio (height / width): 3.5in / 2.5in ≈ 1.4
    const CARD_ASPECT = 3.5 / 2.5; // ~1.4

    // Canvas-based confetti spanning the whole hero section
    function startCanvasConfetti() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById("confetti-canvas");
      if (!canvas) return { stop: () => {} };

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) return { stop: () => {} };

      // Canvas fills the entire hero section (account for DPR)
      const container = canvas.parentElement; // the relatively positioned hero wrapper
      let width = 0,
        height = 0,
        dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      function resize() {
        const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.width));
        height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.height));
        canvas.style.width = width + "px";
        canvas.style.height = height + "px";
        // Fill the container
        canvas.style.left = "0px";
        canvas.style.top = "0px";
        canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      }
      resize();
      const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
      ro.observe(container);

      // Key anchors for spawn points
      const cardZone = document.getElementById("card-confetti-zone");
      const merchAnchor = document.querySelector("#merch-slider a");
      const storeBadges = document.getElementById("store-badges");
      // Use the actual t-shirt image as the spawn origin so it appears from behind the shirt
      const merchSpawnEl = document.getElementById("tshirt-img") || merchAnchor;
      // Disable store-badge spawn points
      const storeLinks = [];

      // Helpers to position relative to the canvas
      function getCenter(el) {
        if (!el) return { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, rect: { width: 0, height: 0 } };
        const crect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        return {
          x: r.left - crect.left + r.width / 2,
          y: r.top - crect.top + r.height / 2,
          rect: { width: r.width, height: r.height },
        };
      }

      // Particle system with pooling (reduced for fewer on-screen particles)
      const MAX_PARTICLES = 140;
      const particles = new Array(MAX_PARTICLES).fill(0).map(() => ({ active: false }));
      let spawnTimerCard = 0; // continuous card emitter

      function spawnOneAt(x, y, speed = 1) {
        const p = particles.find((p) => !p.active);
        if (!p) return;
        p.active = true;
        // Spawn at provided coordinates (with a little jitter)
        p.x = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24;
        p.y = y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14;
        // Initial velocity using a 115° arc centered on straight up (-90°)
        // Use the angle for both vx and vy so motion follows the arc.
        const ARC_DEG = 115;
        const center = -Math.PI / 2; // -90° (up)
        const halfArcRad = (ARC_DEG * Math.PI) / 180 / 2; // ~57.5° in radians
        const angle = center + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * halfArcRad;
        // Angle-weighted launch: closer to straight up => higher speed, lighter gravity
        const dev = Math.min(1, Math.abs(angle - center) / halfArcRad); // 0=center (up), 1=edges (sides)
        const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
        // Speed ranges (slower): center 180–260, edges 110–160
        const spMin = lerp(180, 110, dev),
          spMax = lerp(260, 160, dev);
        const speedMag = (spMin + Math.random() * (spMax - spMin)) * speed;
        // Gravity slightly lighter overall so they still climb before turning
        // center ~75, edges ~130
        const gravity = lerp(75, 130, dev);
        p.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speedMag;
        p.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speedMag; // negative (up) for angles in the arc
        p.ax = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18; // gentle drift
        p.ay = gravity; // per-tier gravity
        // Gravity ramp-up so every particle rises before full gravity applies
        // Longer ramp near up (~0.55s), shorter near sides (~0.32s)
        p.gRamp = lerp(0.55, 0.32, dev) + Math.random() * 0.05; // ~0.32s–0.60s
        // Slightly bigger max size for visibility
        const baseSize = 10 + Math.random() * 18; // ~10–28px
        p.w = baseSize;
        p.h = baseSize; // squares
        p.color = COLORS[(Math.random() * COLORS.length) | 0];
        p.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        p.vr = -3 + Math.random() * 6; // rad/s
        p.life = 3.2 + Math.random() * 1.2; // balanced lifetime
        p.age = 0;
        // Sinusoidal lateral wobble parameters
        // Smaller wobble toward the center, larger on the sides
        p.sineAmp = lerp(6, 18, dev) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
        p.sineFreq = lerp(1.8, 3.4, dev) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3;
        p.sinePhase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        // Rectangles only (no circles), fixed aspect ratio already applied
      }

      // 360° radial spawn (used for t-shirt bursts) with optional smaller size
      function spawnOneRadialAt(x, y, magnitude = 1, sizeScale = 1) {
        const p = particles.find((p) => !p.active);
        if (!p) return;
        p.active = true;
        p.x = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16;
        p.y = y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const speedMag = (220 + Math.random() * 220) * magnitude; // ~220-440 px/s
        p.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speedMag;
        p.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speedMag;
        p.ax = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
        p.ay = 420 * Math.max(1, magnitude);
        const baseWidth = 16 + Math.random() * 24; // 16-40px
        p.w = baseWidth * sizeScale;
        p.h = p.w * CARD_ASPECT;
        p.color = COLORS[(Math.random() * COLORS.length) | 0];
        p.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        p.vr = -3 + Math.random() * 6;
        p.life = 1.1 + Math.random() * 0.7;
        p.age = 0;
      }

      let lastTs = performance.now();
      let rafId = 0;
      // Event-driven bursts
      const listeners = [];
      const addL = (el, ev, fn, opts) => {
        if (!el) return;
        el.addEventListener(ev, fn, opts);
        listeners.push(() => el.removeEventListener(ev, fn, opts));
      };
      // Card hover/click bursts (card emits continuously regardless)
      if (cardZone) {
        addL(cardZone, "mouseenter", () => {
          const c = getCenter(cardZone);
          // Spawn from the middle of the card
          const y = c.y;
          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) spawnOneAt(c.x, y, 1.05);
        });
        addL(cardZone, "pointerdown", () => {
          const c = getCenter(cardZone);
          const y = c.y; // middle
          for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) spawnOneAt(c.x, y, 1.2);
        });
        addL(
          cardZone,
          "touchstart",
          (e) => {
            const c = getCenter(cardZone);
            const y = c.y; // middle
            for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) spawnOneAt(c.x, y, 1.2);
          },
          { passive: true },
        );
      }
      // Merch t-shirt bursts are rendered on a local canvas layered within the merch anchor; handled separately.
      // Store badges bursts (per button)
      if (storeLinks && storeLinks.length) {
        for (const link of storeLinks) {
          addL(link, "mouseenter", () => {
            const c = getCenter(link);
            for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) spawnOneAt(c.x, c.y, 1.05);
          });
          addL(link, "pointerdown", () => {
            const c = getCenter(link);
            for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) spawnOneAt(c.x, c.y, 1.15);
          });
          addL(
            link,
            "touchstart",
            () => {
              const c = getCenter(link);
              for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) spawnOneAt(c.x, c.y, 1.15);
            },
            { passive: true },
          );
        }
      }
      function frame(ts) {
        const dt = Math.min(0.033, (ts - lastTs) / 1000);
        lastTs = ts;

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // Continuous spawn from card ~10/sec
        if (cardZone) {
          spawnTimerCard += dt;
          // Lower continuous emission rate for fewer pieces per second
          const baseRate = 0.22; // ~4.5/sec
          while (spawnTimerCard >= baseRate) {
            const c = getCenter(cardZone);
            const y = c.y; // middle of the card
            spawnOneAt(c.x, y, 1);
            spawnTimerCard -= baseRate;
          }
        }

        for (const p of particles) {
          if (!p.active) continue;
          p.age += dt;
          if (p.age >= p.life) {
            p.active = false;
            continue;
          }
          // Integrate motion
          p.vx += p.ax * dt;
          // Ease gravity in over a short ramp so all rise before descending
          const gFactor = Math.min(1, p.age / (p.gRamp || 0.3));
          p.vy += p.ay * gFactor * dt;
          // Cap downward speed to avoid fast falling
          if (p.vy > 140) p.vy = 140; // allow a bit faster fall for variety
          p.x += p.vx * dt;
          p.y += p.vy * dt;
          p.rotation += p.vr * dt;

          // Fade out towards end of life
          const t = p.age / p.life;
          const alpha = 1 - t * t;

          // Apply sinusoidal lateral wobble without affecting physics position
          const wobbleX = Math.sin((p.sinePhase || 0) + p.age * (p.sineFreq || 0)) * (p.sineAmp || 0);
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
          ctx.translate(p.x + wobbleX, p.y);
          ctx.rotate(p.rotation);
          ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          const w = p.w;
          const h = p.h;
          ctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);
          ctx.restore();
        }

        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);

      // Cleanup
      return {
        stop() {
          cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
          ro.disconnect();
          // Remove listeners
          for (const off of listeners) off();
          // Clear canvas
          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
        },
      };
    }

    // Slider confetti across the entire panel area (group-level canvas)
    function startSliderConfetti() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById("panel-confetti-canvas");
      const anchor = document.querySelector("#merch-slider a");
      const group = document.querySelector("#merch-slider .group");
      const panelImg = document.getElementById("merch-panel-img");
      const tshirtEl = document.getElementById("tshirt-img");
      if (!canvas || !anchor || !group) return { stop: () => {} };

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) return { stop: () => {} };

      // Size canvas to the group box with DPR scaling and extra padding to avoid clipping
      const container = group;
      let width = 0,
        height = 0,
        dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      // Increase padding so particles remain inside the local canvas for their full lifetime
      const PAD_X = 240; // px padding on left/right
      const PAD_Y = 340; // px padding on top/bottom (extra headroom for upward motion)
      function resize() {
        const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Expand canvas beyond the anchor to keep particles from clipping
        width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.width + PAD_X * 2));
        height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.height + PAD_Y * 2));
        canvas.style.left = Math.floor(-PAD_X) + "px";
        canvas.style.top = Math.floor(-PAD_Y) + "px";
        canvas.style.width = width + "px";
        canvas.style.height = height + "px";
        canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      }
      resize();
      const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
      ro.observe(container);

      function getLocalCenter(el) {
        const crect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        const r = (el || container).getBoundingClientRect();
        return {
          x: r.left - crect.left + PAD_X + r.width / 2,
          y: r.top - crect.top + PAD_Y + r.height / 2,
          rect: { width: r.width, height: r.height },
        };
      }
      const MAX_PARTICLES = 140;
      // Restrict colors to palette from provided image (orange/red-orange/blues)
      const TSHIRT_COLORS = ["#F7931E", "#FF6B35", "#0074D9", "#1E90FF"]; // orange, red-orange, blue, light blue
      // Bias toward warm reds/oranges
      const TSHIRT_WEIGHTS = [0.42, 0.33, 0.15, 0.1];
      function pickTshirtColor() {
        const r = Math.random();
        let acc = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < TSHIRT_COLORS.length; i++) {
          acc += TSHIRT_WEIGHTS[i] || 0;
          if (r < acc) return TSHIRT_COLORS[i];
        }
        return TSHIRT_COLORS[TSHIRT_COLORS.length - 1];
      }
      const particles = new Array(MAX_PARTICLES).fill(0).map(() => ({ active: false }));

      function spawnRadialLocal(x, y, magnitude = 0.8, sizeScale = 0.8, count = 16) {
        for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
          const p = particles.find((p) => !p.active);
          if (!p) break;
          p.active = true;
          p.x = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
          p.y = y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
          const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          // Slightly snappier initial speed on hover
          const speedMag = (130 + Math.random() * 150) * magnitude;
          p.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speedMag;
          p.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speedMag;
          p.ax = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24;
          // Lower gravity so upward motion (negative vy) persists longer
          p.ay = 110;
          // Smaller than initial: width ~10–24px before sizeScale
          const baseWidth = 10 + Math.random() * 14;
          p.w = baseWidth * sizeScale;
          p.h = p.w * CARD_ASPECT;
          p.color = pickTshirtColor();
          p.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          p.vr = -2.5 + Math.random() * 5;
          // Nudge vertical velocity upward to bias more particles to the top
          p.vy -= 50;
          // Longer life so slower, upward-traveling particles remain visible
          p.life = 1.8 + Math.random() * 1.0;
          p.age = 0;
        }
      }

      // Upward arc spawn like the card emitter, but localized to this canvas
      function spawnUpwardLocal(x, y, speed = 1) {
        const p = particles.find((p) => !p.active);
        if (!p) return;
        p.active = true;
        p.x = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24;
        p.y = y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14;
        const ARC_DEG = 115;
        const center = -Math.PI / 2; // up
        const halfArcRad = (ARC_DEG * Math.PI) / 180 / 2;
        const angle = center + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * halfArcRad;
        const dev = Math.min(1, Math.abs(angle - center) / halfArcRad);
        const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
        const spMin = lerp(180, 110, dev),
          spMax = lerp(260, 160, dev);
        const speedMag = (spMin + Math.random() * (spMax - spMin)) * speed;
        const gravity = lerp(75, 130, dev);
        p.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speedMag;
        p.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speedMag;
        p.ax = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18;
        p.ay = gravity;
        p.gRamp = lerp(0.55, 0.32, dev) + Math.random() * 0.05;
        const baseSize = 10 + Math.random() * 18; // squares like card emitter
        p.w = baseSize;
        p.h = baseSize;
        p.color = pickTshirtColor();
        p.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        p.vr = -3 + Math.random() * 6;
        p.life = 3.2 + Math.random() * 1.2;
        p.age = 0;
        p.sineAmp = lerp(6, 18, dev) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
        p.sineFreq = lerp(1.8, 3.4, dev) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3;
        p.sinePhase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      }

      // Pick random positions across the panel image (or group if missing)
      function randomPointInPanel() {
        const base = panelImg || container;
        const crect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        const r = base.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = r.left - crect.left + PAD_X + Math.random() * r.width;
        const y = r.top - crect.top + PAD_Y + Math.random() * r.height;
        return { x, y };
      }

      // Event listeners (attached to anchor for hover/click)
      const listeners = [];
      const addL = (el, ev, fn, opts) => {
        el && el.addEventListener(ev, fn, opts);
        listeners.push(() => el && el.removeEventListener(ev, fn, opts));
      };
      // Hover state: initial burst, then continuous upward spawning like the card
      let hoverActive = false;
      let spawnTimerHover = 0;
      addL(anchor, "mouseenter", () => {
        const o = getLocalCenter(tshirtEl || anchor);
        spawnRadialLocal(o.x, o.y, 0.7, 0.85, 18); // initial pop
        hoverActive = true;
      });
      addL(anchor, "mouseleave", () => {
        hoverActive = false;
        spawnTimerHover = 0;
      });
      addL(anchor, "pointerleave", () => {
        hoverActive = false;
        spawnTimerHover = 0;
      });
      addL(anchor, "pointerdown", () => {
        const o = getLocalCenter(tshirtEl || anchor);
        spawnRadialLocal(o.x, o.y, 0.9, 0.9, 24);
      });
      addL(
        anchor,
        "touchstart",
        () => {
          const o = getLocalCenter(tshirtEl || anchor);
          spawnRadialLocal(o.x, o.y, 0.95, 0.9, 24);
        },
        { passive: true },
      );

      let lastTs = performance.now();
      let rafId = 0;
      function frame(ts) {
        const dt = Math.min(0.033, (ts - lastTs) / 1000);
        lastTs = ts;

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // Continuous spawn while hovered (like card emitter)
        if (hoverActive) {
          spawnTimerHover += dt;
          const baseRate = 0.22; // ~4.5/sec
          const o = getLocalCenter(tshirtEl || anchor);
          while (spawnTimerHover >= baseRate) {
            spawnUpwardLocal(o.x, o.y, 1);
            spawnTimerHover -= baseRate;
          }
        }
        for (const p of particles) {
          if (!p.active) continue;
          p.age += dt;
          if (p.age >= p.life) {
            p.active = false;
            continue;
          }
          p.vx += p.ax * dt;
          // Ease gravity in over the first ~0.22–0.40s to guarantee visible rise
          const gFactor = Math.min(1, p.age / (p.gRamp || 0.3));
          p.vy += p.ay * gFactor * dt;
          p.x += p.vx * dt;
          p.y += p.vy * dt;
          p.rotation += p.vr * dt;
          const t = p.age / p.life;
          const alpha = 1 - t * t;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
          ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
          ctx.rotate(p.rotation);
          ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          const w = p.w,
            h = p.h;
          ctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);
          ctx.restore();
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);

      return {
        stop() {

      heroSliderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        const slider = document.getElementById("merch-slider");
        if (!slider) return;
        // Reset initial state to ensure consistent animation after back nav
        slider.classList.add("-translate-x-full");
        slider.style.opacity = "0";
        slider.style.transform = "";

        slider.classList.remove("-translate-x-full", "opacity-0");
        slider.style.opacity = "1";
        // Apply the transform directly to slide it in
        slider.style.transform = "translateX(-40%)";
        // No slider confetti – rectangles image handles hover effect
      }, 2000); // Slide in after 2 seconds

      // Start canvas confetti on the main card (if canvas present)
      const canvas = document.getElementById("confetti-canvas");
      if (canvas) {
        window.__confettiStopper = startCanvasConfetti();
      }

      // Start slider confetti if present
      const sliderCanvas = document.getElementById("panel-confetti-canvas");
      if (sliderCanvas) {

      if (window.__tshirtConfettiStopper && typeof window.__tshirtConfettiStopper.stop === "function") {
        window.__tshirtConfettiStopper.stop();
        window.__tshirtConfettiStopper = null;
      }
      // Hide only non-tshirt parts to allow tshirt to view-transition
      const panelImg = document.getElementById("merch-panel-img");
      if (panelImg) {
        panelImg.setAttribute("style", "transition:none;opacity:0");
      }
      const ctaText = document.getElementById("slider-cta-text");
      if (ctaText) {
        ctaText.setAttribute("style", "transition:none;opacity:0");
      }
      // Hide rectangles image before transition; keep t-shirt visible for view-transition
      const rects = document.getElementById("tshirt-rectangles");
      if (rects) {

        clearTimeout(heroSliderTimeout);
        heroSliderTimeout = null;
      }
      if (window.confettiInterval) {
        clearInterval(window.confettiInterval);
        window.confettiInterval = null;
      }
    });

  // Global function to handle cookie settings
  window.handleCookieSettings = function () {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.CookieConsent) {
      try {
        window.CookieConsent.showPreferences();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error calling showPreferences:", error);
      }
    } else {
      // Wait for CookieConsent to be available
      let attempts = 0;
      const maxAttempts = 10;
      const checkForCookieConsent = () => {
        attempts++;
        if (window.CookieConsent) {
          window.CookieConsent.showPreferences();
        } else if (attempts < maxAttempts) {
          setTimeout(checkForCookieConsent, 500);
        } else {
          console.error("CookieConsent not available after waiting");
        }
      };
      setTimeout(checkForCookieConsent, 100);
    }
  };
